candidates.change_summary: Change the final return from true to false so successful non-reverting calls return false instead of true.
Return the success flag of the last low-level call instead of always true, so the observed return depends on the last call outcome.
Return logical AND of all call success flags (will be false if any call failed), rather than constant true.
Replace the external call to use delegatecall instead of call, causing the invoked code to execute in this contract's context and potentially change observable state after transfer.
Replace the call to revert on failure with continue (ignore failures), so failed external calls do not revert the whole transfer and final state may differ.
Replace the call invocation to use staticcall, making the external call read-only which can change behavior if the callee attempted state changes.
